source_text: Offeret arietem immaculatum sacerdoti. Christus aries; delictum nostrum portat. Sacerdos aestimat.
pass_a_gloss: He-will-offer ram spotless to-priest. Christ ram; offense our he-carries. Priest estimates.
pass_b_english: He brings a [[spotless ram to the priest >> Bible:Leviticus 6:6]]. Christ is that ram; he carries our trespass. The priest values it.
